sources.description: Ghost in the Shell production background art by Hiromasa Ogura. Hong Kong-inspired cityscapes, market sequences, waterway scenes, rooftop panoramas, cybernetics labs. The gold standard for cyberpunk anime environments.
sources.notes: Also search for art book scans of 'The Analysis of Ghost in the Shell'

sources.description: Akira art book illustrations and production art by Katsuhiro Otomo. Neo-Tokyo cityscapes, motorcycle chase backgrounds, SOL satellite, military facilities, detailed mechanical designs.
sources.notes: Akira Club art book is the primary reference. Look for high-res scans.

sources.description: ArtStation professional artists creating cyberpunk anime-style art. Portfolio-quality pieces with consistent high resolution. Filter for anime/illustration style specifically, exclude 3D renders and Western comic styles.
sources.notes: Look for artists citing Otomo, Oshii, or Shirow as influences. Also try search terms: 'neo-tokyo', 'sci-fi anime', 'dark anime cityscape'.

sources.description: Danbooru tagged anime art archive. Combined tags for cyberpunk cityscapes with detailed backgrounds, excluding chibi/cute styles. Large volume but needs quality filtering.
sources.notes: Additional useful tag combos: 'rain+city+night+science_fiction', 'cyberpunk+dark+atmospheric'. Filter for score:10+ for quality.

sources.description: DeviantArt cyberpunk anime art. Fan art and original works. Filter to Digital Art category and sort by popularity for quality control.
sources.notes: Quality is inconsistent. Only take pieces that match the Akira/GitS aesthetic, not generic anime with neon.

sources.description: Pinterest curated mood boards for cyberpunk anime aesthetic. Useful as a discovery tool to find original sources. Most pins are low-res thumbnails -- trace back to originals.
sources.notes: Use Pinterest to discover new artist portfolios or gallery pages, then add those as separate Tier A/B sources.

sources.description: YouTube compilations of Ghost in the Shell and Akira production art. Video slideshows and art book flip-throughs. Extract frames at key moments showing distinct artworks.
sources.notes: Only use 720p+ videos. Set extract interval to 3-5s for art compilations. Also search: 'Akira art book flip through', 'cyberpunk anime art compilation'.

sources.description: Reddit r/Cyberpunk and r/anime community posts with cyberpunk anime art. Also check r/ImaginaryCityscapes and r/ImaginarySliceOfLife for environment art.
sources.notes: Sort by top/all-time for quality. Many are reposts at reduced resolution -- trace to original source when possible.

sources.description: Wallhaven high-resolution anime wallpapers tagged cyberpunk. Good resolution but images may be cropped, AI-upscaled, or otherwise modified from originals.
sources.notes: Filter for resolution 1920x1080+ minimum. Good for gap-filling specific composition types (wide cityscapes, vertical portraits).

total_estimated_images.note: Expect ~50% usability rate after quality filtering. Tier A alone should yield 20-25 usable images.
